newsitem.title: GREECE: CITIBANK SPONSORS GLORY OF BYZANTIUM EXHIBIT.
newsitem.headline: CITIBANK SPONSORS GLORY OF BYZANTIUM EXHIBIT.

text.p: Citibank is sponsoring an exhibition on the "Glory of Buzantium", hosting rare international pieces of art at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, it said in a statement.
"This event is in line with Citibank's supportive attitude towards international art events," William Rhodes, the vice president of Citibank, told a news conference on Monday.
The New York exhibition will include 350 works of art that were created in Byzantine Empire countries, between the ninth and thirteenth centuries, the statement added.
Citibank has borrowed these works from museums of 24 countries around the world where it has offices. Among these are Greece, Poland, Egypt, Turkey and Russia, it added.
Citibank-Greece general manager, Dimitris Krontiras, also addressed the news conference.
"We are proud that we can link Citibank's name to the organisation of this unique exhibition," he said.
The exhibition will last from March 11 to July 6.
Citibank has also sponsored the Gewandhaus Orchestra of Germany, the Museum of Modern Art in Sao Paolo, Brazil and the Children's Museum in Mexico, the statement said.
It has also sponsored eleven times the Philarmonic Orchestra of New York, it added. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
